title: describe_pcb: inspect a PCB session as structured data
summary: New describe_pcb MCP tool returns a compact, structured snapshot of the session board — size + outline, stackup, net classes / design rules, zones, trace & via counts by net and layer, component count, DRC status, and an export/render probe that surfaces the 'DRC-clean but unexportable' state get_document/read can't see.
